visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-purple hair and a white shirt holds a smartphone displaying a video of a famous celebrity. She stands in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and a wooden staircase railing in the background. (2) A man wearing glasses and a black sweatshirt enters the frame, gesturing broadly as he speaks. Various variety-show style text overlays appear around him, illustrating his points with icons like a thinking face and a scorpion. (3) The camera zooms in on the smartphone screen, showing an Instagram profile belonging to Song Hye-kyo. The woman's hands are visible holding the device, which also displays a direct message interaction. (4) The woman holds up a glass bottle of Guerlain Abeille Royale Youth Watery Oil. The bottle is filled with golden liquid and small suspended beads, catching the light as she rotates it against a light-colored interior background. (5) A montage begins showing the woman in a pink plush pajama set stretching on a bed and sitting in a meditative pose with her eyes closed and hands pressed together in a prayer position. (6) Macro shots of the golden product being dispensed from a dropper onto a hand and then applied to the woman's face. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting her skin texture and the shimmer of the oil. (7) A split-screen comparison appears with "Before" and "After" labels, showing the woman's face side-by-side to demonstrate the product's effects. (8) A grayscale nighttime sequence from a baby monitor (CuboAi) shows a baby sleeping under a white blanket, with the woman briefly seen patting the baby. (9) The woman and man reappear together in the room, cheering and clapping. Colorful confetti and a large "Bravo" graphic appear on screen as they smile widely at the camera. (10) A final static promotional graphic displays a set of Guerlain products with detailed pricing and promotional information in Traditional Chinese text.

He speaks rapidly with varying pitch contours. (3) A 'ding' SFX punctuates the appearance of on-screen text while the upbeat music continues at a steady volume level underneath the clear dialogue. (4) The female narrator transitions to a more narrative, professional tone as she describes product benefits. The BGM remains energetic, but the vocal delivery becomes more measured and focused. (6) The video concludes with a burst of laughter and canned applause SFX, followed by a 'Bravo' shout from the male character, blending into a final upbeat musical stinger.
